exposure: Induction of labor method (Misoprostol vs. other methods: vaginal PGE2, amniotomy, oxytocin, balloon catheter)
Women with no prior vaginal delivery
cohort: 208 women attempting induction of labor after one previous cesarean section
finding: The shift to oral misoprostol as the primary method of induction in women with a previous cesarean section did not increase the frequency of uterine rupture.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in the frequency of uterine rupture when comparing induction of labor using vaginal PGE2, amniotomy, oxytocin, or a balloon catheter with orally administered misoprostol in women with a previous cesarean section.
